blocked_sentences: You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying {2}{W} rather than paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a residual-gate claimant in authoring/verify.py `_covered` for the unkeyworded printed line "You may cast this card from your graveyard by paying <mana> rather than paying its mana cost" on a permanent card, matched strictly against the card-level `graveyard_cost` mana (with `graveyard_cast: "graveyard"`, since the card is not exiled afterwards). The engine side already works: the card written with `graveyard_cost: {"mana": "{2}{W}"}` and `graveyard_cast: "graveyard"` passes all six gates once this line is removed from the oracle text
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `graveyard_cost`/`flashback` lines are claimed only by `spell_effects` (instants/sorceries), the `Mayhem` and `Escape—` keyword claimants, and `_ALTERNATIVE_COST_LINE`, which reads `alternative_cost` (not the graveyard slot) and requires "rather than pay" not "rather than paying". No ability can honestly carry the line: a `cast_from_graveyard` static would permit the cast at the printed {W}, not {2}{W}, so the sentence stays residual and gate 3 rejects the card
